n01.roman: Mission: Hastinapur Rath Chase! Mahabharat ki Kuru rajdhani. Yahan gaadi nahi — rath!

n02.roman: Ab twist! Hastinapur naam sirf kahaani mein nahi milta. Meerut zile mein, Ganga kinare, aaj bhi ye shehar hai.

n03.roman: 1950 se 1952 tak, B.B. Lal ne yahan khudaai ki. Unke mutabik, teele mein Ganga ki badi baadh ke nishaan dikhe — shaayad 800 isa purv ke.

n04.roman: Puraani katha mein likha hai: Raja Nichakshu ke samay baadh Hastinapur ka bada hissa baha le gayi, aur rajdhani Kaushambi chali gayi. Par dono ko jodna pakka saboot nahi.

n05.roman: Toh game ka final level? Chase police se nahi — baadh se! Paani se pehle Kaushambi pahuncho!
